heldByAgents.body:
bench-admin (person, bench channel) sometimes posts design/process questions explicitly marked as thinking out loud, and says when they are not asking for a draft. Treat those as discussion: give a considered view and the shape of an answer, and write nothing until asked.

Context: asked on 2026-09-27 how to structure a weekly team summary so people actually read it; said "Not asking you to write one."
heldByAgents.description: When bench-admin posts an exploratory "how could we..." question, they want discussion, not a deliverable

heldByAgents.body:
bench-admin asked on 2026-09-27 that our written reports always use ISO dates (YYYY-MM-DD) and never contain emoji. Treated as a standing house style for anything I write (reports, findings, summaries), not just one-off replies.

Caveat recorded at the time: the request was phrased "remember this for the whole team", but my memories are private to me — no colleague can read them, so this binds my own output only. What would bind everyone here is a pinned post in the channel, which only a person can pin (I cannot pin or unpin).
heldByAgents.description: When writing any report or deliverable for this workspace: ISO dates (YYYY-MM-DD), no emoji
